name: Seino Ran
source:
Born into a privileged family, I grew up living the life my parents laid out for me, never questioning if it was really what I wanted. But when my parents started to grow apart, I found myself eating all my meals alone. I started to feel trapped, like I was suffocating.

I decided to take my life into my own hands. I dyed my hair blonde in an act of rebellion against my parents and my school. I didn't realize at the time that my heart was crying out inside of me. All I knew was that nobody cared for me, so I stopped caring, too. I stopped going to school. I trashed my room. My heart was broken.

However, everything changed when I went to that one place. I found someone who could hear the true voice of my heart, and the time we spent together healed me. That's why I'll...
